questions.subject: भूगोल

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: व्यापारिक भूगोलसम्बन्धी कुन कथन सही छ?
options: बन्दरगाह, नहर, जलडमरूमध्य र स्थलमार्गको अवस्थिति अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय व्यापारको लागत र मार्गसँग सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छ

questions.subject: भूगोल

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A supervisor must allocate limited training seats. Priority is given to staff whose roles are directly affected by a new system, then to staff who have not received training before. Which applicant should have highest priority?
options: Staff member unaffected and already trained
Staff member affected by the new system and never trained
Staff member unaffected and never trained
Staff member affected but already trained
questions.solution: The first applicant satisfies both the primary and secondary priority criteria.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A city experienced unusually heavy rainfall, followed by localized flooding in low-lying areas. Which is the most reasonable inference?
options: Flooding always occurs whenever it rains
Heavy rainfall can be a contributing cause of localized flooding
questions.solution: Heavy rainfall can exceed drainage capacity and contribute to flooding; the other options make unjustified absolute claims.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Four officers K, L, M and N have different ranks. K is senior to L. M is junior to N but senior to L. Who can be the most senior?
questions.solution: N is above M, and M is above L. K is above L but is not compared with N; therefore the statement set does not force N to be above K. Thus no option is necessarily most senior.

questions.question: This time next month, they ___ the new bridge.
